properties.note: Visible maintained fairway south of the tree-lined tee area, curving west toward green5. The driving range to the east is excluded; low-contrast dormant mowing boundaries remain provisional.
Visible gray sand footprint northeast of green1; gray tone may include water in the depression.
Visible southern sand footprint west of green1.
Visible gray sand footprint southwest of green2; adjacent bare soil apron not included.
Visible small sand footprint east of green3.
Visible northern sand bunker east of green7.
Visible southern sand bunker east of green7.
Visible sand bunker west of green8.
Visible larger sand bunker south of green8.
Visible smaller sand bunker southeast of green8.
Visible gray bunker south of green9.
Visible bunker east of actual green10, replacing the OSM footprint displaced onto the green.
Visible sand bunker east of green11.
Visible irregular sand bunker southwest of green11.
Visible southern approach bunker of hole11; complete footprint reaches the panel edge, source image checked beyond the crop.
Visible gray bunker west of green12.
Visible western bunker near green16; source OSM already supplies northern and eastern bunkers.
Visible dormant-season fairway stripe south of the path crossing, ending west of the pond. No route buffer or pond crossing surface was constructed.
Visible maintained strip leading northwest to green4; freeform mowing edge followed between neighboring bunkers. Dormant contrast limits edge interpretation.
Observed short-grass approach northwest of the pond. The water gap is preserved by using a separate landing-area polygon.
Visible landing fairway south and east of the pond. Maintained boundary follows the drained edge and mowing contrast; water itself excluded.
Visible diagonal maintained strip from the woodland exit toward green8, with the irregular mowing boundary preserved. No fairway invented through the wooded tee area.
Visible maintained rear platform within the larger apron south of the clubhouse. Marker colors and present-day pad edge are unverified.
Visible forward platform east of the route start; physical pad only, no color attribution.
Small maintained platform immediately west of the path; its southwestern edge has tree-shadow interpretation uncertainty.
Distinct maintained platform south of the clubhouse access road, surrounded by trees.
Visible maintained diagonal platform southeast of route start. Adjacent apron excluded as far as the dormant-season contrast supports.
2019 rear platform partly bounded by tree shadows. The newer undated municipal image shows substantial changes here; current tee10 geometry requires review.
Long maintained platform between the road and the walking path, with tree-shadow uncertainty along its west edge.
Triangular maintained platform north of green11 and north of the path junction. OSM incorrectly tags this location as a green; guide and route identify tee12.
Small visible maintained platform west of Trolldalsvagen, north of green14.
Eastern physical platform southeast of green13. The western pad near the route start is obscured by trees, so it is not reconstructed.
Actual visible maintained green east of the displaced OSM green10 ring; eastern sand edge used only to distinguish the neighboring bunker.
Dormant-season mowing boundary is low contrast. Guide used only to identify the green, not to supply its coordinates.
Visible maintained green edge, with broad northern section and narrower approach-side section. Boundary interpretation needs newer summer imagery.
Visible kidney-shaped maintained green south of the small bunker; apron not intentionally included.
Visible elongated green west of two sand bunkers; no bunker or apron vertices adopted as green.
Green at the eastern end of hole12. Route endpoint lies toward the approach; it was not used as a polygon centre.
Visible diagonal maintained green below the path near Trolldalsvägen. Current mowing/edge needs newer imagery review.

Visible maintained central fairway extent in the 2019 dormant-season orthophoto, following the bend from the northwestern landing area toward the eastern green. The low-contrast apron beside the greenside bunkers is left outside this trace. The public summer map view corroborated identity and gross mowing pattern only; every adopted vertex is measured in the retained 2019 source image. Current mowing, recent alterations and absolute registration remain unverified.

Observed central maintained fairway patch east of the western green; dormant-season contrast makes some edge turns interpretive. The shaded western approach beside trees is left untraced because its 2019 edge cannot be followed reliably. The polygon excludes the green, woodland and the separate southern hole. It does not extend toward the tee by route buffering. Public summer imagery corroborated which short-grass strip belongs to this route; all vertices retain the 2019 source-pixel positions.
Visible sand footprint southeast of green10, replacing the OSM bunker displaced southwest onto the fairway. The larger light-soil surrounding bank is excluded.
Distinct physical platform southwest of the existing mapped forward platform. Its western edge is partly shadowed. No marker-color assignment.
Distinct rear physical platform beside the path crossing, south of the other tee2 platforms; retained2019 footprint only.
Elongated middle platform west of the path; complete southern end checked in the extended2019 source crop. Guide4 corroborates the combined middle-platform identity, not color positions.
Small forward platform inside the bend of the path. Maintained edge is visible in2019 and gross position matches guide4.
Clear forward platform east of the path bend before hole10 fairway; marker colors unresolved.
Longer middle platform southeast of the path, separate from both the rear2019 pad and forward pad. Southern boundary inspected beyond the initial crop.
Visible western physical platform on the open lawn north of the upper parking area. Existing OSM tee17 is a different northern platform.
Visible eastern physical platform north of the old upper parking area; later practice-area construction remains a separate2025 change review.
Visible western fairway sand footprint; guide4 corroborates the bunker on the left of the approach, with98m distance annotation.
Visible eastern fairway sand footprint; guide4 corroborates the bunker on the right of the approach, with147m distance annotation.
Visible sand/water footprint east of green5. Surrounding bare-soil apron and drain depression north of it are excluded; guide5 corroborates greenside bunker identity.
Visible gray sand footprint left of fairway5 in north-up imagery; adjacent hole8 lies farther west. Current guide corroborates this side bunker.
Visible northern approach bunker east of hole7 fairway, before the greenside pair.
Visible southern approach bunker northeast of hole7 pond.
Visible gray sand footprint on the eastern edge of the middle hole10 fairway, north of the smaller pair.
Visible middle sand footprint in the fairway10 eastern bunker group.
Visible southern small sand footprint in the fairway10 eastern bunker group.
Visible approach bunker southwest of green12, separate from the previously mapped bunker immediately west of the green.
Visible northern sand footprint near the hole14 fairway approach; bare-soil surroundings are not adopted.
Visible southern sand footprint near the hole14 fairway approach.
